thread:
alex: Quick postmortem follow-up: authz outage root cause still points at two patterns: token validation edgecases with reused sessions and silent fallback flows that escape audit. Also found stale service keys on a dev pipeline. Need a short remediation sweep with clear owners and hard dates.
alex: Proposal: 8 business days to ship probes, logging, and rotations. Weekly 20m standup until closed.
priya: I can take probe work for token validation. Plan: add a "replay-long-token" integration test that exercises refresh+reuse, plus a cron probe in staging. ETA 3 days to PR, 2 more for canary.
omar: I will own audit coverage. Action: enumerate middleware bypasses, add explicit audit events on fallback auth code paths, and backfill missing events for the past 30 days to the audit-store. Need 5 days incl. backfill.
kelly: I'll handle secrets rotation for any service accounts with TTL > 90d and wire alerts into PagerDuty. Will run a short inventory and schedule rotations; need security approval for revoke window.
ops-bot: calendar invite created: "authz-remediation-standup" Tue/Wed 20m recurring.
sec-team: A quick note: rotations that revoke keys require dep owners to have refresh logic. Please attach dependency list.
alex: Good call. Owners: priya=validation probes, omar=audit, kelly=secrets+alerts. I'll be PM owner. Each owner post a one-paragraph rollback plan and link PRs here.
priya: Probe design: simulate token reuse via env var TOKEN_REPLAY=true in staging-only config. Also add a histogram metric: token_reuse_latency. PR coming: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/5123
ci-bot: CI started for runtime#5123.
omar: Audit shim PR: https://github.com/redwood/authz/pull/2231. This adds audit.emit("fallback_auth", metadata) in three places. Will canary at 2% before 20% rollout.
kelly: Inventory done: svc-ci, svc-ml, svc-legacy. svc-legacy has a 180d key, will rotate first. Rotation window proposed: 3340003000-3340006600 UTC. Security please confirm.
sec-team: Acking rotation window; sec will run dependency check in 4 hours. If any blocking deps found, we'll postpone.
priya: Quick ops note: make sure probes hit both cached and direct verification paths. I saw a false negative previously when cache TTL was high.
omar: Backfill plan: run audit-replay job to re-emit events for missing fallback cases into audit-store via incremental job; checkpointing to avoid duplicates.
kelly: I'll also add TTL drift monitor to infra-alerting: if key_ttl_days > 30 send warning, >60 escalate.
ops-bot: canary deploy scheduled for audit-shim at 3340002500.
priya: Merged probe PR to staging, cron set to every 5m. Will watch for flaky failures.
ci-bot: runtime#5123 passed tests and deployment to staging started.
omar: Audit shim canary metrics look clean, events flowing to audit-store.
kelly: Rotation executed for svc-legacy at 3340005400. Old key will be revoked 3340070000 as agreed.
alex: Closing criteria: (1) probes green for 72h in prod-staging parity, (2) audit events present for fallback paths in prod for 48h, (3) rotated keys plus TTL alerting enabled. If all met, we'll mark follow-up complete and add items to security runbook.
priya: One follow-up: add unit test asserting that retry logic propagates telemetry id so fallback events are associated. Adding to PR backlog.
omar: Post-deploy check: run a sample of past 7 days to verify backfilled events match expected schema.
kelly: Created PagerDuty escalation rule: authz-key-rotation-fail.
ops-bot: reminder set: "authz-remediation-standup" tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
ci-bot: audit#2231 CI passed and canary deployed.
alex: Thanks team. Please paste PRs + any infra flags here. Reopen thread if regressions appear. :thumbsup:
